assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The service directly addresses the denial under Reason Code CO-50.
The clinical indication demonstrates a documented need to evaluate the symptomatic events for arrhythmia.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The service is Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229).
The denial was made based on Reason Code CO-50.
The denial was made by Atlas Mutual.
The service was not deemed medically necessary by Atlas Mutual according to current clinical guidelines and coverage policies.
The patient has the right to file an appeal.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within the timeframe specified in the plan documents.
All supporting clinical documentation must be included to facilitate a thorough review of the medical necessity.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
